info.title: VisionGuidedPick Teach Target and Observe API
info.description: Single-user product API; no login. Exact-IP and same-origin writes. Observe owns only recognition, never robot commands. See observe-api.md for runtime and quality limits.

post.description: Independent of Observe and Auto Pick state. One training worker at a time. Starting training does not stop or replace the running Observe model. No hyperparameter or resume/checkpoint override accepted. Same idempotency key returns the same job; changed images/config require a new job.

Error.description: Structured error; see human guide for codes

original_filename.description: Uploaded filename basename; legacy records may omit it.

source_label.description: Optional operator-provided camera/capture-session label. Not inferred from filename.

outcome.description: Computed from explicitly reviewed instances; never inferred from a pending empty mask.

eta_sec.description: Estimated remaining training time, available after the first measured epoch; excludes final evaluation.

eta_updated_at.description: UTC Unix seconds when ETA was measured.

augmented_train_count.description: Job-local synthetic training samples in addition to train_count.

training_history.description: Actual Lightning CSV epoch history; missing values stay absent, not zero.

bundle_format.description: Self-contained bundle. Absent on legacy manifests, which Publish and activation refuse with MODEL_BUNDLE_LEGACY until explicitly migrated.

class_mapping.description: Model output class index (decimal string) to label.

evaluation.description: Held-out evaluation summary copied at bundle time; per-image overlays remain under evaluation_url while the job exists.

source.description: Traceability only: resolved training section and worker-recorded library versions (null when migrated from a job that did not record them).

contract_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON over model_version, checkpoint_sha256, class_names, class_mapping, preprocessing and evaluation.

inference_contract.description: Present after real worker ACK; input resolution/color/dtype/preprocessing and contiguous class mapping.

preview_hz.description: Configured preview request frequency; unique rendered frames remain source/inference limited.

inference_hz_limit.description: Configured inference cap, not measured achieved frequency.

box_estimated.description: Dashed projection from recent accepted depth. False for current measured bounds or no box.

detected_count.description: Confirmed objects in the current Observe run and clock epoch, including objects outside the recent history.

outcome_counts.description: Settled outcomes per confirmed object in the current Observe run and clock epoch, including evicted rows.

display_id.description: Consecutive confirmed-object sequence. A later track merge may compact the sequence.

reason.description: Provided when a confirmed target crosses the final pick area without an assigned arm.

outcome.description: Live task.last_result.outcome when the idle task (phase 0) has the same epoch, cycle_id and track_id; otherwise null. Not read from diagnostic files. Outcome 1 is a controller release report, not bin-load evidence.

position.description: Radians for revolute joints, meters for prismatic joints.

effort.description: N·m for revolute joints, N for prismatic joints.
